Nothing runs an agent until you press the button.

writer.offerTitle: Let an agent write the product pages

knowledge.refreshNote: “Refresh” reads the code again from the new commits and checks the links of the pages. The agent then edits only the pages that need it (listed above), keeping every sentence whose grounds did not change; with a new language it translates all pages. Each unit is bound by {{turns}} turns and {{minutes}} minutes.

historyNote.manyCommits: The list names {{total}} commits; the first {{shown}} are shown.
historyNote.manyFiles: The commit changed {{total}} files; the first {{shown}} are shown.
historyNote.noCounts: {{count}} of the files report no line count: a binary file, or a path a rename left behind.
historyNote.merge: This commit changed no file of its own: it is a merge, and the changes came in with the branches it brought together.
historyNote.noFiles: This commit changed no file of its own.
historyNote.partialFiles: The files below count the commits shown; a commit with more files than this page reads adds only the ones it shows.
historyNote.symbolsCut: The file {{path}} holds more entities than this page counts; its symbol figure covers the first {{shown}}.
historyNote.population: All reachable non-merge commits count once, including merged branch work. Merge diffs do not inflate hotspots or coupling.
historyNote.observedAuthorship: These are observed contributions, not recorded organizational ownership. Each commit counts once for this module.
historyNote.cochangeNotCause: Co-change is not an import and does not prove causation. Counts cover the full histories of both file identities.
historyNote.noImport: The indexed import relations show neither direction between these coupled files.
historyNote.importCoverage: Some indexed import targets have no complete file membership. No absence of an import is claimed.
historyNote.membershipCoverage: Containment membership is incomplete. These counts cover only the indexed member files, not a complete module or package.
historyNote.dateAnomaly: The raw committer date is not later than the parent’s ({{parent}}). History follows ancestry and strictly increasing effective time; raw dates are retained.
historyNote.mergeBranch: Branch {{branch}} entered the first-parent line in this merge on {{date}}.
historyNote.unchangedMove: Git identified an unchanged-content move. The old and new paths share one continuous history; the move counts once.

agent.intro: The coding agent that writes the product pages. madarch runs it through its ACP adapter, only when a fill or a refresh starts; your subscription terms apply.

places.store: Graph store (derived; a fill builds it again)

danger.title: Dangerous actions
danger.intro: Both actions are local to this machine and change only this copy of the product.

danger.keeps: Everything else stays: documents and pages people wrote, the code repositories under repos/ and the choice of the agent.
danger.nothingSent: Nothing is committed or sent anywhere. A copy of the product on another machine, and its remote repository, are not touched.

fresh.what: Removes the agent's pages and the graph, puts the manifest and the templates at the current starter set and starts a fresh fill.
fresh.graph: the graph store on this machine: {{store}};
fresh.starter: the {{files}} starter files (the manifest madarch/kinds.yaml and the templates) are put at the current starter set;
fresh.edited: These starter files were edited by a person and the edit is replaced (it stays in git history only if it was committed): {{list}}.
fresh.fill: then a fresh fill reads the code and the agent writes the pages.
fresh.fillRefused: The pages and the graph were removed, but the fill did not start: {{reason}} Put that right, then press Refresh in the top bar.
